canonical_name: Bellman-Ford weighted shortest-path algorithm family (exact proposition open)
literal_source_claim_zh: 带负权边的最短路径算法
literal_source_claim_en: A shortest-path algorithm with negative-weight edges.
source_attribution: Richard Bellman and Lester Ford, 1958 (catalog metadata only; not a source citation)
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies an algorithm name and capability gloss, not a proposition. It omits the graph and weight model, source and reachability contract, infinity and shortest-distance definitions, negative-cycle scope, algorithm state and relaxation schedule, output, predecessor and tie behavior, and whether the target is distance correctness, path reconstruction, cycle detection, termination, complexity, implementation refinement, or a conjunction. Selecting a familiar textbook theorem at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix a finite directed graph or multigraph/quiver, vertex and edge universes, source and optional target, signed ordered additive weight domain, infinity or unboundedness representation, and all finiteness and decidability assumptions.
conclusion: Open: the catalog does not choose distance equality, path-witness correctness, negative-cycle detection, termination, pass or runtime complexity, executable refinement, or a specified conjunction.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before an exact source proposition is approved; every graph, reachability, cycle, weight, iteration, arithmetic, and output case in scope-map.md remains open.
candidate_scope_not_credited: single-source distance correctness after |V|-1 full relaxation passes when no source-relevant negative cycle exists
correct predecessor-path reconstruction for every reachable vertex with finite shortest distance
sound and complete detection of a negative-weight cycle reachable from the source by a final relaxation scan
termination and O(|V||E|) running time under a fixed edge-list and unit-cost arithmetic model
refinement of a concrete executable implementation to a mathematical Bellman-Ford recurrence
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty and singleton vertex types, no edges, absent source, isolated and unreachable vertices
source-to-source distance, self-loops, parallel edges, zero-weight and negative-weight edges
reachable and unreachable negative cycles and cycles unable to reach a queried target
multiple equal shortest paths, predecessor ties, and zero-weight cycles
walk weights unbounded below versus finite shortest values and infinity conventions
early stopping, edge traversal order, in-place versus snapshot passes, and a final relaxable edge
exact weights versus fixed-width integer or floating-point overflow and sentinel behavior
excluded_substitutions: Floyd-Warshall all-pairs correctness, DAG shortest paths, breadth-first search, or unweighted shortest-path length
additive path-weight identities, path optimality, or existence of a minimizing path without algorithm correctness
cycle detection without the selected distance/output contract or distance correctness without a selected cycle boundary
acyclic, nonnegative, fixed-size, or otherwise specialized graph results unless source-frozen
a structure or hypothesis storing the desired distances, paths, detector result, or correctness conclusion
a finite execution trace, benchmark, numerical test, pseudocode example, or unchecked certificate
the catalog's untrusted verified label, a citation, or the discovery probe used as proof credit
